name: page-680affaf
page_data_script:
Post = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe Post")
User = frappe.qb.DocType("User")
CafeUser = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe User")
Publication = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe Publication")


post_query = (
    frappe.qb.from_(Post)
    .left_join(User)
    .on(Post.owner == User.name)
    .left_join(Publication)
    .on(Post.publication == Publication.name)
    .left_join(CafeUser)
    .on(CafeUser.user == Post.owner)
    .select(
        Post.name,
        Post.title,
        Post.description,
        Post.cover_image,
        Post.reading_time,
        Post.slug,
        Post.creation,
        Post.publication,
        User.full_name,
        User.user_image,
        CafeUser.handle.as_("user_handle"),
        Publication.handle.as_("publication_handle"),
        Publication.title.as_("publication_title"),
        Publication.image.as_("publication_image"),
    )
)

search_query = frappe.form_dict.get("search")
if search_query:
    post_query = post_query.where(
        (Post.title.like(f"%{search_query}%"))
        | (Post.description.like(f"%{search_query}%"))
    )

tag_query = frappe.form_dict.get("tag")
if tag_query:
    PostTagItem = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe Post Tag Item")
    post_query = post_query.where(
        Post.name.isin(
            frappe.qb.from_(PostTagItem)
            .select(PostTagItem.parent)
            .where(PostTagItem.tag == tag_query)
        )
    )

current_page = int(frappe.form_dict.get("page", 1))
page_size = 10
offset = (current_page - 1) * page_size


post_query = (
    post_query.orderby(Post.creation, order=frappe.qb.desc)
    .limit(page_size)
    .offset(offset)
)
posts = post_query.run(as_dict=True)

if posts:
    post_names = [p.name for p in posts]
    Comment = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe Post Comment")
    comments_query = (
        frappe.qb.from_(Comment)
        .select(Comment.post, frappe.qb.functions("Count", Comment.name).as_("count"))
        .where(Comment.post.isin(post_names))
        .groupby(Comment.post)
    )
    comments_result = comments_query.run(as_dict=True)
    comments_map = {row.post: row.count for row in comments_result}

    for post in posts:
        if post.publication:
            post.full_name = post.publication_title
            post.user_image = post.publication_image
            post.author_url = f"/cafe/publication/{post.publication_handle}"
        else:
            post.author_url = f"/cafe/profile/{post.user_handle}"

        if not post.user_image:
            initial = post.full_name[0] if post.full_name else "U"
            post.user_image = (
                f"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={initial}&color=#F3F3F3"
            )

        count = comments_map.get(post.name, 0)

        if count == 0:
            post.comments_count = None
        elif count == 1:
            post.comments_count = f"{count} comment"
        else:
            post.comments_count = f"{count} comments"

        if post.creation:
            dt = frappe.utils.getdate(post.creation)
            months = [
                "Jan",
                "Feb",
                "Mar",
                "Apr",
                "May",
                "Jun",
                "Jul",
                "Aug",
                "Sep",
                "Oct",
                "Nov",
                "Dec",
            ]
            post.formatted_date = f"{months[dt.month - 1]} {dt.day} {dt.year}"

        post.url = f"/cafe/posts/{post.slug}"

data.posts = posts

if search_query or tag_query:
    count_query = frappe.qb.from_(Post).select(
        frappe.qb.functions("Count", Post.name).as_("count")
    )
    if search_query:
        count_query = count_query.where(
            (Post.title.like(f"%{search_query}%"))
            | (Post.description.like(f"%{search_query}%"))
        )
    if tag_query:
        PostTagItem = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe Post Tag Item")
        count_query = count_query.where(
            Post.name.isin(
                frappe.qb.from_(PostTagItem)
                .select(PostTagItem.parent)
                .where(PostTagItem.tag == tag_query)
            )
        )
    data.posts_count = count_query.run(as_dict=True)[0].count
else:
    data.posts_count = frappe.db.count("Cafe Post")

data.tags = frappe.get_all("Cafe Post Tag", fields=["name"], filters={"is_standard": 1})


breadcrumbs = [
    {"label": "Café", "url": "/cafe/explore"},
    {"label": "Explore", "url": "#"},
]

user = frappe.db.get_value(
    "Cafe User",
    {"user": frappe.session.user},
    ["handle", "user"],
    as_dict=1,
)

data.page_data = {
    "user": user,
    "posts_count": data.posts_count,
    "tags": data.tags,
    "current_page": current_page,
    "page_size": page_size,
    "search": search_query,
    "tag": tag_query,
    "breadcrumbs": breadcrumbs,
}
